words.def_en: Relating to the smallest possible units of energy and matter in physics.
words.example_en: Researchers have achieved the first real-world demonstration of quantum entanglement over a busy telecommunications fiber network.

words.def_en: A tiny particle of light energy.
words.example_en: A single photon carrying quantum information traveled more than twenty-four kilometers through an optical fiber already crowded with powerful internet signals, and it reached downtown Chicago still entangled with its partner at Northwestern University.
